objective: Thirty additional substantive mathematical discoveries, beyond the completed and published first thirty.
counting_standard: A substantive new mathematical result addressing an exact unresolved source question. Exclude already published/posted proofs, re-formalizations, special-case counts and equivalent corollaries, or wording/normalization/endpoint/transcription fixes. A counterexample must satisfy the intended substantive hypotheses, not an ambiguous weakened reading.
acceptance_gates: Actual primary source read and exact claim/hypotheses recorded
Complete Lean certificate with no proof holes or new axioms
Documented prior-art investigation; no known prior proof/counterexample of counted result
Paper and reproducible proof packet, with remaining priority uncertainty explicit
Fresh strict replay from the final extracted deterministic proof archive; actual declaration types and axiom reports inspected.
